answer: Cross-Epoch Divergence Cap. Each identity has a long-run behavioural profile across recent epochs (action timing, peer set, response latency). A rule flags any identity whose profile deviates from its own history beyond a fixed ridge of drift, then requires the change to be explained by a public fable of prior commitments logged before the shift. Unjustified divergence triggers a cooldown that resets accumulated trust to a baseline knoll.
